hooks.name: Activity heartbeat
hooks.description: After each Agent turn, record a session heartbeat (time and workspace only, no chat content) in ~/.local/state/open-company/activity/ so the progress report can show that an IDE session was active.

hooks.name: Chat capture
hooks.description: After each Agent turn, copy new user prompts and Agent replies (text only, secrets redacted, no tool calls) from this turn's Kiro session transcript into ~/.local/state/open-company/chat/ so the progress report can show the actual conversation, not just a heartbeat.
